blocks.text: Thermal physics physics ka aham hissa hai jo heat (hararat), work (kaam), temperature (darja hararat) aur energy ki doosri shaklon ke aapas ke talluq ko parhta hai. Thermodynamics ke laws (qawaneen) batate hain ke kisi system mein energy kaise badalti hai aur system apne aas paas (surroundings) par faida mand kaam kaise kar sakta hai. Bohat se atoms ya molecules wala bara system macroscopic system kehlata hai, aur sirf ek atom ya ek molecule wala system microscopic system. Macroscopic system ki properties (khasiyatein) jaise temperature aur pressure poore system ki thermal properties hain; inhein molecules ka zikr kiye baghair dekha aur parha ja sakta hai. Microscopic system ki properties kinetic energy aur momentum jaisi hain. Thermal physics mein hum bohat zyada particles (zarrat) se kaam karte hain, Avogadro's number ke barabar tadaad ke. Yeh particles gases, liquids aur solids ke atoms ya molecules ho sakte hain. Isi soch ko metals mein electrons ki harkat aur neutron stars ke neutrons tak bhi phailaya ja sakta hai.

Rozmarra zindagi mein kinetic theory of gases ke bohat se istemal hain, maslan gaariyon ke engines, turbines, pumps, air conditioners, khana tayyar karna (production of food) aur mahol (environment). Inhi mukhtalif istemalat ki wajah se thermal physics aham hai.
Thermal physics mein statistical mechanics aur kinetic theory of gases dono ka ilm shamil hai; thermal physics parhne ke liye in dono ka ilm zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Macroscopic aur microscopic system mein kya farq hai? Har ek ki ek property batayein.
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic system mein bohat se atoms ya molecules hote hain (property: temperature ya pressure); microscopic system sirf ek atom ya molecule hai (property: kinetic energy ya momentum).

items: Thermal physics: heat, work, temperature aur energy ka talluq.
Macroscopic (T, P) aur microscopic (K.E., momentum) systems.
Is ke liye kinetic theory of gases aur statistical mechanics dono chahiye.
